# Privacy Policy for SnapScheduler **Effective date:** 12 August 2026 SnapScheduler is a screenshot scheduling utility that allows users to capture screenshots of web pages and optionally send them through services configured by the user. ## Information We Collect SnapScheduler may collect or process: * Website URLs entered by the user * Screenshot images generated by the app * Scheduling preferences created by the user * Basic app usage information required for app functionality ## How We Use Information The information is used only to: * Capture screenshots requested by the user * Execute scheduled screenshot tasks * Deliver screenshots to destinations configured by the user (such as Telegram or email, if enabled) ## Data Storage User-created schedules and settings may be stored locally on the device or in services chosen by the user. We do not sell personal information. ## Third-Party Services SnapScheduler may interact with third-party services selected by the user, such as Telegram or email providers, solely to deliver screenshots or notifications requested by the user. ## Data Sharing We do not sell or rent user data. Information is shared only with third-party services that the user explicitly configures for screenshot delivery. ## Security We take reasonable measures to protect information used by the app. However, no method of electronic storage or transmission is completely secure. ## Children’s Privacy SnapScheduler is not directed toward children under 13 years of age. ## Changes to This Policy We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The updated version will be posted at the same URL. ## Contact If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, contact: **Anil Kumar** Email: [aks.apps10@gmail.com](mailto:aks.apps10@gmail.com)
